prose: The Financial Times reports that multiple staff at the UK's AI Safety Institute have been signed off work with stress, with tight model release schedules and fears about AI contributing to low morale and burnout. Top researchers at AISI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind report burnout and stress tied to developing powerful AI systems.
highlights: Multiple UK AISI staff have been signed off work with stress, per FT sources.
Tight model release schedules and AI fears are cited as drivers of low morale and burnout.
Researchers at AISI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind report similar strain.
